title: Cognichip Launches Commercial Semiconductor Design AI, Announces Adoption by Renesas and SiTime
excerpt: On September 14, 2026, Cognichip announced the commercial launch of its semiconductor design AI "ACI Enterprise" and its adoption by Renesas and SiTime. We explain its role in the design process, what RTL and PPA mean, and what to keep in mind when reading reports of time savings.
